decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the core psychiatric offer and moved up to the home page in 2024, so it meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
Senior living counseling has been on the home page in both years, costs few resources, and feeds the eldercare business, so it performs at or above aspiration.

The sheltered workshop retail shop gained visibility in 2024 and supports workshop employment goals, and although the related carpentry offer was dropped, the slack of an expanding firm lets it keep carrying the shop.

Meal delivery for seniors is new and its results are still uncertain, but it is close to the established eldercare business, and the firm's growth gives it enough slack to keep it while it is evaluated.
